images.filename: "Almighty God as Created the Mind Free . . ." at Jefferson Memorial.jpg
images.caption:
I took this photo of panel of the northwest interior wall the Jefferson Memorial on a recent trip to DC.
Inscription
Almighty God hath created the mind free...All attempts to influence it by temporal punishments or burthens...are a departure from the plan of the Holy Author of our religion...No man shall be compelled to frequent or support any religious worship or ministry or shall otherwise suffer on account of his religious opinions or belief, but all men shall be free to profess and by argument to maintain, their opinions in matters of religion. I know but one code of morality for men whether acting singly or collectively.

images.filename: The Thomas Jefferson Memorial is along the Tidal Basin with an excellent view of many other prominent D.C. memorials and the (b946dcc4-a67e-4d25-a8aa-765ca26d3e0f).JPG
images.caption:
Spherical image of inside a circular memorial chamber that features a statue of Thomas Jefferson in the center. The exterior of the plaza features panels with Jefferson's writings and columns to outside.
The Thomas Jefferson Memorial is along the Tidal Basin with an excellent view of many other prominent D.C. memorials and the White House. The memorial is a nod to Jefferson's appreciation of architecture and full of symbolism and connections to his life and legacy featuring some of his most influential writings inside the chamber.
